extracted.name: Mango sgroppino
extracted.description: Tropical mango makes for a a summery twist on this classic Italian cocktail – experiment with other flavours of fruit sorbet, too
instruction_lines: Put a scoop of mango sorbet into each of four chilled glasses.
Pour over the passion fruit liqueur, if using, then top up with prosecco and serve immediately.
